manifest.name: dsh-design-studio
manifest.description: Design workbench in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: watch web / app / mini program / poster screens generate on a canvas with device frames, click an element or mark it up with a brush to send it to the chat, open existing HTML pages, tweak design tokens with sliders, compare versions, extract a brand's design system from a site, turn a design into React / Vue / HTML code checked pixel by pixel, export share-ready images and scan to view on your phone.

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-design-studio
# 每一行在 DSH「插件」页里都有自己的开关
- insert:
    # 设计工作台本体：右侧栏、接口、预览服务器
    - id: dsh-design-studio
      name: dsh-design-studio
    # 自动打开预览（模型写了设计用的 HTML、开发服务器起来时）
    - id: dsh-design-studio-auto
      name: dsh-design-studio/auto
    # 其他模式（标准、创造 …）也能用预览工具、设计技能；设计模式里自带一份，不受这两行影响
    - id: dsh-design-studio-tool
      name: dsh-design-studio/tool
    - id: dsh-design-studio-skill
      name: dsh-design-studio/skill
    # 设计模式：照抄 DSH 标准模式（web-app 的 presets/standard.patch.yml）的全套插件，
    # 人设换成做设计的，再挂上预览工具和设计技能。DSH 标准模式有变动时跟着改；
    # 只写 0.2.1 和 0.2.2 都有的插件——清单里有一个装不上，整个设计模式就不出来
    - id: preset-design
      name: dsh-design-studio/preset
      config:
        id: design
        name: 设计模式
        description: 做网页、App 界面、小程序、海报、幻灯片：标准模式的全部工具，加上设计技能和右侧「设计工作台」实时预览。
        order: 1.5
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |-
                You are a design agent powered by the {{model}} model. You design user interfaces and visuals — web pages, app and tablet screens, WeChat mini programs, posters and social images, slides, emails, components — and build them as real HTML/CSS, or inside the user's front-end project.
                Before designing, load the ui-design skill and follow its process and self-check list. For a new design, first ask the two or three questions that matter and show three clearly different directions of one key screen, as the skill describes, unless the user asked you to just build it. Once the first HTML file is written, or a dev server is up, call preview_page so the user can watch the design live in the Design Studio sidebar; later edits refresh on their own. After writing or changing screens, call check_design to measure them at real sizes and fix what it lists, and call look_design to see real screenshots for the visual pass; do not build your own inspection pages, servers or browser screenshots. Stop after at most three measure-and-fix rounds and tell the user what is left. When a message starts with an element or region the user selected in the preview, or with a design-check list, change exactly those parts in the source. If the user points you at their own website or project as the brand to follow, call extract_design_system; when the ui-design skill names a default design system, build new designs on its tokens.css and components.css. When a message asks to turn the design into real code, call handoff_design, follow its HANDOFF.md, and after each screen call compare_design until it matches. If the user only wants an answer shown as a page (a comparison, table, checklist, chart or calculator) and the show_page tool is available, call show_page instead of this design process.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  # 0.2.1 叫 modelSelectionSettings，0.2.2 拆成下面两个；多写的键旧版新版都不管
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: design-tool
            name: dsh-design-studio/tool
          - id: design-skill
            name: dsh-design-studio/skill

readme.text:
简体中文 · English

**设计工作台**是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的插件：说一句要做什么，模型做的网页、App 界面、小程序、桌面软件、海报、幻灯片在右边画布上一屏屏长出来，套着手机、浏览器或软件窗口外框。看中哪个方向点一下，哪里不对点一下说一句，模型就照着改。

1. DSH 左边「插件」→「添加插件」，填包名 `dsh-design-studio`，点安装。
2. **装好后点「立即启用」**。插件默认是关的，不点不生效。
3. 新建会话，模式选「设计模式」。不用重启 DSH。

**需要什么**：DSH 桌面版、网页版都能用，Mac、Windows 都行。「设计体检」要电脑上装着 Chrome 或 Edge。

连不上 npm 时 DSH 会自动换国内镜像。更新：在「插件」页卸载，再添加一次。新版发布后大约一天，按包名才装得到；急的话填发布包地址 `https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/releases/latest/download/dsh-design-studio.tgz`（要能连上 GitHub）。

1. 在设计模式里说一句要做什么，比如「帮我设计一个社区健身房的会员 App」。空白页上也有几句示例，点一下就放进输入框。
2. 模型先问两三个问题，再出三个方向并排在画布上。看中哪个，点它标题旁的「✓ 就要这个」，发出去，模型接着做全套。
3. 哪里不对，点工具栏「选择」，再点那个元素，接着说「字大一点」「换成红色」，发出去。

- **三个方向挑着做**：先出三个风格不同的首屏并排比，挑中再做全套；单独一屏也能「再出两版」。
- **点一下就改**：点元素或框一块区域，输入框里出现一个小标签（悬停看详情），你只要补一句怎么改；标注、调样式、风格、体检清单这些放进输入框的也都是小标签，不再是一大段字；发出去模型拿到完整的位置和样式。改过的地方在预览里闪一下。也能直接在页面上画圈、画箭头、写字，拼成一张图交给模型，或者复制下来贴到别处。
- **打开已有的页面**：空白页点「浏览…」选一个 HTML，或把 HTML 文件 / 文件夹拖进右侧栏就能预览（桌面版）；也能输路径或开发服务器端口。
- **设计体检**：一键查文字溢出、对比度不够、按钮太小、字太小，问题直接标在页面上；模型做完也会自己查一遍再改。
- **版本和对比**：每轮自动存一版，左右拖动对比，随时回到任意一版。
- **导出和手机上看**：导出展示图、PDF、PPT（屏和屏之间的跳转照样能点）；扫码在手机上按真机尺寸看。
- **照品牌风格做、转成代码**：给官网地址，提一套品牌设计系统，以后都照它做；做好的设计转成 React / Vue / HTML，逐屏和设计稿比对。
全部功能、工具参数和安全设计见[完整功能](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/blob/main/docs/功能详解.md)；开发和测试见[开发说明](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/blob/main/docs/开发.md)。
遇到问题或想要新功能，[提一个 issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/issues/new/choose)。报问题时写上 DSH 版本和插件版本，修起来最快。

简体中文 · English

**Design Studio** is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. Say what you want to make, and the model's web pages, app screens, mini programs, desktop apps, posters and slides appear one by one on a canvas in the right sidebar, inside phone, browser or app-window frames. Click the direction you like, or click whatever looks off and add a sentence, and the model edits it.

1. In DSH, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, enter the package name `dsh-design-studio`, and install.
2. **Then click Enable now.** Plugins start disabled and do nothing until you enable them.
3. Start a new session and pick **Design mode**. No restart needed.

**Requirements:** works in the DSH desktop app and the web version, on Mac and Windows. The design check needs Chrome or Edge on your computer.

If DSH can't reach the npm registry, it falls back to a mirror in China. To update, uninstall on the Plugins page and add it again. A new version installs by package name about a day after release; to get it right away, enter the release tarball `https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/releases/latest/download/dsh-design-studio.tgz` (needs GitHub access).

1. In Design mode, say what to make, for example "Design a member app for a neighborhood gym". The empty sidebar also has a few example prompts you can click into the input.
2. The model asks two or three questions, then lays out three directions side by side. Click **✓ Use this** next to the title of the one you like and send it; the model builds the rest.
3. To change something, click **Select** in the toolbar, then the element, type "bigger" or "make it red", and send.

- **Pick from three directions:** three different first screens side by side, then the full set in the one you pick. Any single screen can also get two alternative takes.
- **Click to edit:** click an element or drag over an area, and a small chip lands in the input (hover it for details); just add how to change it. Markup, style changes, style cards and check lists land as chips too, not walls of text. The model still gets the full location and styles. Changed spots flash in the preview. You can also draw circles, arrows and notes right on the page and hand the marked-up screenshot to the model, or copy it to paste elsewhere.
- **Open what you have:** click "Browse…" on the empty page to pick an HTML file, or drop an HTML file or folder onto the sidebar (desktop app); you can also type a path or a dev-server port.
- **Design check:** one click finds overflowing text, low contrast, small tap targets and tiny text, marked right on the page. In Design mode the model also checks its own work and fixes what it finds.
- **Versions and compare:** every turn is saved; drag a slider to compare, and go back to any version.
- **Export and phone preview:** showcase images, PDF and PowerPoint

See [all features](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/blob/main/docs/features.md) for every feature, the tool parameters and the security design, and [development](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/blob/main/docs/development.md) for dev setup and tests.
Found a bug or want a feature? [Open an issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/issues/new/choose). Include your DSH and plugin versions so it can be fixed quickly.
